Non-Aligned Movement.fact: The Non-Aligned Movement (NAM) is a forum of 121 countries that are not formally aligned with or against any major power bloc.  It was founded with the view to advancing interests of developing countries in the context of Cold War confrontation.  After the United Nations, it is the largest grouping of states worldwide.  The movement originated in the aftermath of the Korean War, as an effort by some countries to counterbalance the rapid bi-polarization of the world during the Cold War, whereby two major powers formed blocs and embarked on a policy to pull the rest of the world into their orbits.  One of these was the pro-Soviet socialist bloc whose best known alliance was the Warsaw Pact, and the other the pro-American capitalist group of countries, many of which belonged to NATO.  In 1961, drawing on the principles agreed at the Bandung Conference of 1955, the Non-Aligned Movement was formally established in Belgrade, Yugoslavia, through an initiative led by Yugoslav president Josip Broz Tito, Egyptian president Gamal Abdel Nasser, Indian prime minister Jawaharlal Nehru, Ghanaian president Kwame Nkrumah, and Indonesian president Sukarno

Peter and Paul Fortress.fact: The Peter and Paul Fortress (Russian: Петропавловская крепость, romanized: Petropavlovskaya krepost') is the original citadel of Saint Petersburg, Russia, set up by Peter the Great in 1703 and built to Domenico Trezzini's designs from 1706 to 1740 as a star fortress.

Peter and Paul Fortress.subject: International Relations
Peter and Paul Fortress.question: On 25 _____ (O.S.), the fortress quickly fell into Bolshevik hands
Peter and Paul Fortress.fact: On 25 October (O.S.), the fortress quickly fell into Bolshevik hands. At 02:10 on the morning of 26 October (O.S.), the Winter Palace was taken by forces under Vladimir Antonov-Ovseenko; the captured ministers were taken to the fortress as prisoners.

Peter and Paul Fortress.subject: International Relations
Peter and Paul Fortress.question: At 02:10 on the morning of 26 October (O.S.), the _____ was taken by forces under Vladimir Antonov-Ovseenko; the captured ministers were taken to the fortress as prisoners
Peter and Paul Fortress.fact: Following the ultimatum from the Petrograd Soviet to the Provisional Government ministers in the Winter Palace, after the blank salvo of the cruiser Aurora at 21:00, the guns of the fortress fired 30 or so shells at the Winter Palace. At 02:10 on the morning of 26 October (O.S.), the Winter Palace was taken by forces under Vladimir Antonov-Ovseenko; the captured ministers were taken to the fortress as prisoners.
